story_title: WS over PTY raw bytes デモ (desktop 単一クライアント)
notes: PoC 用スタンドアロンバイナリ cmd/poc-pty/ が対象。 既存 palmux2 (cmd/palmux/) には影響を与えない
Test convention: palmux2 全体は Python + Playwright を採用しているため、 gui-spec の TypeScript テンプレートではなく Python (.py) 形式で生成
PoC 用 fixture は palmux2_test_fixture() ではなく poc-pty バイナリを直接起動する minimal fixture を使う (Story 3 で同時に実装)
AC-3-4 (manual smoke ログ) は file-existence + size>0 の自動チェックを sprint verify で行う。 内容生成自体は人間が manual smoke で書く
state_diagram_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Connecting: page load → ws.open()
    Connecting --> Connected: ws onopen
    Connecting --> Disconnected: ws error before open
    Connected --> Streaming: first byte from server
    Streaming --> Connected: 1s idle (no new bytes)
    Connected --> Disconnected: ws close (daemon down / nav away)
    Streaming --> Disconnected: ws close mid-stream
    Disconnected --> Connecting: user clicks Reconnect / page reload

states.name: Connecting
states.description: WebSocket ハンドシェイク中。 xterm.js は描画準備済みだがバイトはまだ来ていない

states.name: Connected
states.description: WS open、 アイドル状態。 ユーザ入力を受け付け、 サーバへ送信可能

states.name: Streaming
states.description: サーバから raw bytes が流入中。 xterm.js が逐次描画

ui_affordances.input: enabled (input continues during stream — TUI が制御)

states.name: Disconnected
states.description: WS が close または error。 xterm.js は最後のフレームを保持して停止

scenarios.name: Happy path: connect → echo prompt → see response
steps: Open static HTML served by cmd/poc-pty/ on its port
WS open → state transitions Connecting → Connected
User types prompt + Enter into xterm.js
Bytes flow daemon → PTY → claude; response flows back daemon → WS → xterm.js
xterm.js canvas contains response text within 5 seconds

scenarios.name: Reconnect with replay
steps: xterm.js canvas re-displays previous scrollback (look for known token from first prompt)

scenarios.name: Manual smoke log artifact
steps: Human opens browser to its static HTML
Automated check (sprint verify) asserts the file exists and is non-empty
